entities.name: Eliel Soisalon-Soininen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johan Mårten Eliel Soisalon-Soininen was a Chancellor of Justice of Finland. Soisalon-Soininen was assassinated in 1905 at his apartment in Helsinki by a young student Lennart Hohenthal.
